text:
mira.marketing: Quick sync  small launch note for tomorrow's benchmark snapshot. We're doing a tight embargo: 07:00 PT. Need final sign-off on press list, spokespersons, and a contingency if a partner publishes early.

olivia.pr: Who are confirmed spokes? I have Tony (CEO) and Head of Research on roster. Any regional spokes for EU/APAC?

mira.marketing: Tony + Head of Research primary. For EU we can offer a local engineering contact if requested. Keep it to two on-record names.

dan.engineering: FYI eng want to limit deep technical interviews to 48-hour window post-publish. We'll accept quick clarifying calls but route deep dives to scheduled sessions.

carla.legal: Please avoid superlatives in the headline copy. Also confirm there's a clear correction path if numbers are updated.

olivia.pr: Understood. Draft PR email uses measured language. Will include an "Errata" link in the footer and point to dataset provenance.

mira.marketing: Press list draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-presslist-2156. Two notes: 1) One partner (CloudY) has a preprint scheduled the same day; 2) a tech influencer has early access and may post a thread.

pressbot: [automated] Embedded note: 1 partner flagged for potential preprint overlap. Outbound embargo emails will be scheduled once PR triggers.

olivia.pr: For the CloudY overlap  let's proactively reach out to their comms lead and offer a short briefing. If they publish first, we'll push an "official analysis" follow-up rather than a correction.

dan.engineering: Agreed. Also flag: one chart has an interactive view that doesn't render on AMP previews; recommend a static fallback in social assets.
mira.marketing: Good catch. I'll add static PNGs for Twitter/X and LinkedIn.

carla.legal: Approving the copy with one change: replace "unmatched" with "industry-grade" in the blurb. Also confirm KMS/HSM language is non-binding.

ton y.ceo: (tony.ceo) Small tweak to quote: "We build inference that behaves in production, not just in benchmarks." OK to use?

olivia.pr: Nice line. I'll keep it short.

mira.marketing: Schedule: final assets to drive by 06:00 PT tomorrow, PR to paste final email at 06:15 PT, legal to sign off by 06:30 PT, pressbot to send at 07:00 PT on PR cue. Support to open triage channel at publish.

support.ops: We'll open #support-bench-live at publish and have 2 engineers on rotation for the first 2 hours. Will prepare a short customer-facing FAQ.

pressbot: [automated] Ready to schedule: embargo emails to 22 contacts. Waiting for PR trigger.

mira.marketing: Small contingency: if the influencer posts early, we will (A) post an initial clarification thread within 10 minutes, (B) offer a short technical brief to any reporter that requests it.

olivia.pr: Noted. I'll draft the clarifying thread now and keep it queued. Also preparing a short "what changed" note if we need to update numbers.

dan.engineering: Will standby for rapid questions in #eng-ml. Quick nudge: please avoid routing reporter requests through personal DMs. Use official channels.

mira.marketing: All set. If no objections, we'll proceed with this plan. Please thumbs-up.

olivia.pr: :+1:

carla.legal: :+1:

pressbot: [automated] Sending embargoed emails in 15 minutes unless cancelled.

mira.marketing: Publishing now. Blog URL: https://blog.redwood.ai/2026/bench-snapshot-live. Press emails sent.

olivia.pr: First reporter reached out  asks for a 15-min clarifying call. Routing to dan.engineering.

support.ops: Traffic spike noted but within expected range. No incidents.

dan.engineering: On it. Handling clarifying call.

mira.marketing: Great work everyone. Post-launch debrief at 11:00 PT today in #marketing-retros. We'll capture follow-ups and any press asks.

pressbot: [automated] Summary: 22 emails sent, 10 opens in first 10 minutes, 4 replies requesting follow-ups. Thread closed for scheduling.
